name: Acme Retail
description: Seed dataset for demo mode and the main test fixture (PLAN §19). Generated from src/acme; do not edit by hand.

gates.name: new_checkout_flow
gates.description: One-page checkout. Staff first, then beta testers, then a 20% public rollout.

gates.name: checkout_express_pay
gates.description: Express pay button. Depends on new_checkout_flow, which has a partial rollout (cannot be inlined exactly).

gates.name: checkout_promo_banner
gates.description: Promo banner for staff only; references a gate with no partial rollout (inlinable).

gates.name: checkout_upsell_v2
gates.description: Post-purchase upsell. Only one of two rules requires new_checkout_flow, so a prerequisite is not equivalent, and the reference cannot be inlined (partial rollout).

gates.name: express_pay_fallback
gates.description: Legacy pay button for users who fail new_checkout_flow (fails_gate on a gate with a partial rollout: no prerequisite can express it).

gates.name: non_staff_survey
gates.description: NPS survey for everyone who is not staff (fails_gate on an inlinable gate: inlined as a negation).

gates.name: consumer_pricing
gates.description: Consumer prices for accounts that fail b2b_bulk_ordering. That gate has overrides, so “fails” cannot be inlined exactly.

gates.name: free_returns
gates.description: Launched to everyone; the staff rule left below the public rule can never match.

gates.name: checkout_targeting_gate
gates.description: Targeting gate for checkout experiments: US web users.

gates.name: kill_switch_payments
gates.description: Emergency kill switch for the payments provider integration.

gates.name: maintenance_mode
gates.description: Show the maintenance page.

gates.name: employees_only
gates.description: Anyone with an Acme email address.

gates.name: search_v2
gates.description: New search backend for paying plans. `any` is case-insensitive in StatSig.

gates.name: search_autocomplete
gates.description: Autocomplete for specific QA accounts (case-sensitive match).

gates.name: search_typo_tolerance
gates.description: Typo tolerance, excluding test accounts and some locales.

gates.name: reviews_v2
gates.description: New reviews widget for everyone except load-test accounts: a 0% rule is an exclusion.

gates.name: cross_sell_matrix
gates.description: Cross-sell for shoppers missing items in two category sets. Two not_array_contains_all conditions multiply into 12 LD rules (cap 10).

gates.name: dark_mode
gates.description: Dark mode on browsers with good CSS variable support.

gates.name: legacy_browser_banner
gates.description: Upgrade banner for old Safari.

gates.name: windows_download_cta
gates.description: Desktop app CTA on Windows 10+. `version_gte` must map to semVerLessThan + negate.

gates.name: pwa_offline_mode
gates.description: Offline mode for PWA shell 1.2+. Two-part version target: StatSig pads it to 1.2.0; LD semver wants three parts (exact after padding).

gates.description: In-store POS sync for firmware 2.1.0.450+. Four-part build version: StatSig compares all four parts; LD semver never matches a four-part string.

gates.name: eu_cookie_banner
gates.description: Cookie consent banner in the EU (country derived from IP). Tagged “★ Core”, which LD tags cannot spell.

gates.name: black_friday_2027
gates.description: Black Friday pricing; starts in the future → scheduled change or decision.
